item.description:

  • 英語名: Koumigami Nageki Warau Hebigami, Imouto Naru Monomono ga Tsumugishi Folklore

别名

  • Koumigami ~Nageki Warau Hebigami

あらすじ

There exists an island with a Shrine, where a Snake God is worshiped. The deity demands that the siblings of the Shrine marry each other, and, if the precept is broken, a curse supposedly will fall upon the family. Protagonist’s father did not follow this custom and married a woman, who was not related to him by blood. He fathered a son (the protagonist) and a daughter. After their father dies, their mother begins to act weird, while a mysterious man shows up on the island, asking about the old family custom and the curse….

item.title: Gokuin no Sentou
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Black Cyc
  • 発売日: 2011-05-27
  • スコア: 6.49/10 (76 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 獄淫の尖塔
  • 英語名: Gokuin no Sentou

あらすじ

Taking an ordinary tour of his sister’s workplace, Mitsuya Harunobu had expected the day to be friendly and amusing – not a desperate struggle for survival. The voice that echoed through his head was cold and malicious, “Only one with the strongest desire shall earn freedom.” In the passing of a single moment, the gleaming corporate tower was reborn into a sadistic infernal prison: an unknown malevolent force had seized control of the building and corrupted nearly every person within. Rape. Torture. Murder. These were now normality. Somehow unaffected by the supernatural entity, Harunobu resolved his sister would escape the incomprehensible nightmare unharmed - even if Harunobu would have to sacrifice himself in the process.

  • 英語名: MinDeaD BlooD Shihaisha no Tame no Kyoushikyoku

别名

  • MinDeaD BlooD Complete Edition

あらすじ

Just off the coast of mainland Japan is the island of Chisakura, home to a city of the same name, where the heralds of darkness are slowly gathering. Host to a prosperous economy, with a nationally renowned academic institution for young women and an equally upstanding medical research facility, the community has unwittingly attracted the attentions of dreaded supernatural creatures with few equals: vampires. Yet even these immortal predators have daring individuals who hunt them, and a secret war between the two powers is quickly racing to an apocalyptic conclusion. At the center of this nightmarish struggle is a man who has the potential to tip the scales in favor of one side or the other. His choice of allies - the hunters, the vampires, or none at all - may very well determine the fate of humanity and the undead.

あらすじ

A group of six people–two teachers, two male and two female students–rents a yacht, only to find a stowaway, a girl named Tachikawa Nanami. Shortly after, violent seas wreck their ship and force them ashore an island. What are the intentions of the beautiful woman named Sayoko and her maid K, who offer them shelter in her mansion until the ferry arrives in 30 days? What are Nanami’s intentions? Time is running out.
